title: Automatic Power Factor Control Panel
description: Automatic Power Factor Control Panel for any loads to maintain unity power factor and reduce power bills.
subtitle: APFC Panel
fullDescription: We offer Automatic Power Factor Control Panel for any loads. Power factor is the ratio between the KW and the KVA drawn by an electrical load where the KW is the actual load power and the KVA is the apparent load power. In industry most of the load is inductive in nature which results in lagging power factor that is why there is loss and wastage of energy which results in high power bills and heavy penalties from electricity boards. If the load is uneven it is very difficult to maintain unity power factor. This drawback is overcome by using an APFC panel (Automatic Power Factor Correction Panel).
features: Reduces loss and wastage of energy

specifications.benefits: Reduces power bills and heavy penalties from electricity boards
